tokens.name: fg-default
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-default and bg-surface.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, ghost/outline button labels and the React Flow attribution, on bg-default and bg-surface.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: De-emphasised metadata, placeholders, keyboard-shortcut badges and the resting scrollbar thumb, on bg-surface.

tokens.name: fg-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on bg-inverse and on any solid status fill (info/success/warning/danger).

tokens.name: bg-default
tokens.usage: The app and canvas ground; set on html, body and #root.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: node cards, panels, popovers, the toolbar, React Flow controls.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for neutral ghost and outline controls and menu rows.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Solid neutral fill: primary buttons and the tooltip body; pair with fg-inverse.

tokens.name: edge-default
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers, the node hover ring and the Firefox scrollbar thumb, on bg-surface. The source writes the dark value as oklch(1 0 0 / 10%); it is the same colour.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: The interaction colour: selection outlines, snap guides, selected edges, focus borders, the active shortcut badge and info toasts.

tokens.name: info-light
tokens.usage: Glow companion to info: the selection outline's box-shadow and the hovered sketch stroke's drop-shadow.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Info toast surface and the hover fill of info-toned outline/ghost buttons.

tokens.name: info-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for controls sitting on info-bg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text, borders, badges and solid success buttons.

tokens.name: success-light
tokens.usage: Quieter success accent for dashed outlines and secondary marks.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Success toast surface, added-diff background and success control hover.

tokens.name: success-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for controls sitting on success-bg.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text, borders, badges and solid warning buttons; also the missing-file banner icon.

tokens.name: warning-light
tokens.usage: Dashed warning outlines, and the base of the PDF highlight wash.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning toast surface and warning control hover.

tokens.name: warning-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for controls sitting on warning-bg.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive and error text, borders, badges and solid danger buttons.

tokens.name: danger-light
tokens.usage: Quieter danger accent for secondary marks.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Danger toast surface, removed-diff background and danger control hover.

tokens.name: danger-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for controls sitting on danger-bg.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: The AI provenance colour: badges and outlines on anything an agent authored or changed.

tokens.name: ai-light
tokens.usage: 30% AI wash for AI badge borders and dividers.

tokens.name: ai-bg
tokens.usage: 10% AI wash behind AI summary banners and agent-authored sections.

tokens.name: diff-added-bg

tokens.name: diff-removed-bg

tokens.name: diff-removed-text

tokens.name: question-fg

tokens.name: question-border

tokens.name: pdf-selection-border
tokens.usage: Border of a PDF region selection.

tokens.name: skeleton-2
tokens.usage: Mid stop of a skeleton loading bar.

tokens.name: skeleton-3
tokens.usage: Centre stop of a skeleton loading bar.

tokens.name: accent-white
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `white`. Achromatic: node text falls back to fg-default instead of tinting.

tokens.name: accent-grey
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `grey`. Theme-independent: a node keeps its accent in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `teal` — the deepest accent; good for node borders and edges.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `blue`.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `green`.

tokens.name: accent-amber
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `amber`, shown to users as Yellow. Never rename the token: canvases store it.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `orange`.

tokens.name: accent-red
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `red`. An accent, not a status colour — danger is separate.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Canvas accent token `purple`.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Sketch-only ink, prepended to the accent palette for high-contrast strokes.

tokens.name: ms-red
tokens.usage: Microsoft logo dot in the Huabu mark. Logo only — never a UI colour.

tokens.name: ms-green
tokens.usage: Microsoft logo dot in the Huabu mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: ms-blue
tokens.usage: Microsoft logo dot in the Huabu mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: ms-yellow
tokens.usage: Microsoft logo dot in the Huabu mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: mark-ink

families.serif: ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
families.agent: "Comic Sans MS", STXingkai, KaiTi, "Kaiti SC", cursive

styles.name: base
styles.usage: Large button labels and dialog body copy.

styles.name: sm
styles.usage: The interface default: menu rows, toast messages, panel body, medium buttons.

styles.name: sm-medium
styles.usage: Medium and large button labels, banner titles, emphasised rows.

styles.name: xs
styles.usage: Small buttons, node chrome labels, helper text.

styles.name: meta-11
styles.usage: Missing-file path lists and other dense metadata.

styles.name: badge-10
styles.usage: On-node status badges (AI provenance, node state).

styles.name: shortcut-9
styles.usage: The keyboard-shortcut subscript in a button's bottom-right corner.

styles.name: node-default
styles.usage: Note and text node body in the default family. The size is auto-fitted to the node box; 1.5 line-height is fixed.

styles.name: node-serif
styles.usage: Text node body when the user picks the serif family.

styles.name: node-mono
styles.usage: Text node body when the user picks the mono family.

styles.name: node-hand
styles.usage: Text node body when the user picks the hand family.

styles.name: agent-body
styles.usage: Agent (question) node body. Fixed family, auto-fitted size, 1.5 line-height.

styles.name: lod-32
styles.usage: Minimal-LOD node title for a node whose representative canvas size is under 300px.

styles.name: lod-52
styles.usage: Minimal-LOD node title for a representative size of 300-600px.

styles.name: lod-76
styles.usage: Minimal-LOD node title for a representative size of 600px and up. Wraps to at most 6 lines, then ellipsizes.

spacing.note: Canvas measures come from the shared canvas-engine; chrome spacing is the Tailwind scale as the components use it.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The canvas grid cell. Drives the dot background, React Flow snapGrid and every programmatic layout, so nodes and the grid can never disagree.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge gaps inside node chrome.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight chrome inset; TextNode vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Toolbar item gap and small-button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-and-label gap in medium buttons; toolbar row padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Small-button horizontal padding; skeleton line gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Medium-button horizontal padding; node text horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; large-button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: node-padding-x
tokens.usage: Left and right padding inside a text node, used by both the renderer and the text measurer.

tokens.name: node-padding-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding inside a text node.

tokens.name: agent-node-padding
tokens.usage: Padding on all four sides of an agent (question) node.

tokens.name: agent-depth-offset
tokens.usage: How far the agent node's depth board is offset down-left behind the sticky note.

tokens.name: frame-padding-min
tokens.usage: Floor on a frame's derived internal padding; above the floor padding is 10% of the median child extent, so it scales with content.

tokens.name: frame-capture-margin
tokens.usage: Halo around a free-mode frame in which the drag pointer still counts as inside it.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Width of every scrollbar lane; the thumb is transparent until the pointer enters the lane.

tokens.name: resize-line-hit
tokens.usage: Invisible hit strip on a node's edge resize controls; the visible outline stays a hairline.

tokens.name: resize-handle-mouse
tokens.usage: Corner resize handle for the mouse (square, no radius).

tokens.name: resize-handle-touch
tokens.usage: Corner resize handle for touch and pen.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline chips, skeleton bars, on-node badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs by default; the React Flow controls cluster; the tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The node card and the agent node's depth board; the floating toolbar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, accent swatches and scrollbar thumbs.

shadow.note: shadow-bottom is the repo's own token; the elevation trio are Tailwind v4 defaults as the node card uses them. The selection glow is a box-shadow built from info-light at paint time and cannot be a static token.

tokens.name: shadow-bottom
tokens.usage: Floating chrome that hovers over the canvas: the toolbar and the tooltip.

tokens.name: elevation-hover
tokens.usage: A node card on hover, and while it is being edited.

tokens.name: elevation-drag
tokens.usage: A node card while it is dragged.

tokens.name: elevation-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, toast and panel borders, and the selection outline.

tokens.name: border-node
tokens.usage: The node card's accent border. Transparent when the node has no accent; on an image node it is painted as an overlay so it never changes the media's aspect box.

tokens.name: border-swatch
tokens.usage: The ring around an accent swatch — edge-default at rest, info when selected.

canvas.note: Interaction constants that decide what the canvas looks like at a given zoom. Screen-space values are divided by zoom before use, so the on-screen feel stays constant.

tokens.name: zoom-min
tokens.usage: Lowest viewport zoom, shared by React Flow and the custom pinch handlers.

tokens.name: zoom-max
tokens.usage: Highest viewport zoom.

tokens.name: lod-threshold
tokens.usage: Screen-space node width at which note, pdf and web nodes swap their body for a minimal label.

tokens.name: lod-hysteresis
tokens.usage: Buffer around lod-threshold: a full node collapses below 140px, a minimal one expands at 160px.

tokens.name: lod-fade
tokens.usage: Cross-fade between a node's full body and its minimal placeholder.

tokens.name: lod-max-lines
tokens.usage: Hard cap on wrapped lines in a minimal label before it ellipsizes.

tokens.name: badge-min-width
tokens.usage: Screen-space node width below which provenance chrome (the AI badge) is hidden.

tokens.name: snap-threshold
tokens.usage: Screen-space distance at which a dragged node snaps to an alignment guide.

tokens.name: snap-max-guides
tokens.usage: Most alignment guides drawn in one frame.

tokens.name: drag-activation-mouse
tokens.usage: Movement before a mouse press becomes a drag.

tokens.name: drag-activation-pen
tokens.usage: Movement before a pen press becomes a drag.

tokens.name: drag-activation-touch
tokens.usage: Movement before a touch becomes a drag.

tokens.name: sketch-merge-distance
tokens.usage: Screen-space gap within which a new stroke is merged into a nearby sketch node.

tokens.name: sketch-eraser-default
tokens.usage: Default eraser radius; the user can set 4px to 64px.

tokens.name: sketch-stroke-default
tokens.usage: Default sketch stroke size; the slider spans 1px to 32px.

tokens.name: accent-fg-mix
tokens.usage: How much accent is mixed into fg-default for text and icons on an accent-tinted node.

tokens.name: accent-bg-mix
tokens.usage: How much accent is mixed over bg-surface for a node's tinted fill.

tokens.name: accent-border-mix
tokens.usage: Accent strength for a node's 3px border — quieter than the 100% an edge of the same accent uses, so border and edge still read as one family.

tokens.name: accent-divider-mix
tokens.usage: Accent strength for a thin divider inside a node.

tokens.name: accent-soft-mix
tokens.usage: Accent strength for a static section tint inside a node.

tokens.name: accent-highlight-mix
tokens.usage: Accent strength for an inline text highlight.

tokens.usage: A disabled control.
